speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with a concerning rash and recent health changes; let's start by asking when exactly these symptoms began and how they have progressed since then.

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with a rash that started last night, finding it very concerning. He does not recall being exposed to any new environmental stimuli such as detergents or plants like poison ivy. He mentions he recently started seeing a primary care provider for arthritis management and a new onset cough.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced hypersensitivity syndrome (DRESS) or acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis (AGEP) secondary to new arthritis medication, given the acute onset of rash, new cough, and recent initiation of a new primary care provider's treatment regimen.
